On April 3rd, someone at Maple Ridge pulled our "Building a Defensible IEP Goal Library" whitepaper. That's a specific question, and I wanted to respond to it directly.

Caseload consistency at 756 IEPs is its own compliance problem. When goal language varies across case managers and therapists, defensibility gaps appear exactly when an audit or due-process complaint surfaces. Journify works alongside your existing IEP system to give every member of the SPED team. case managers, teachers, and related-service providers. a shared, structured starting point for goal writing. IEP materials generated in under five minutes, with every output labeled AI-generated and requiring educator approval, so your team owns the record and can stand behind it.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week so I can show you how districts your size are building consistent, audit-ready goal libraries?
